typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const ll LIM = LLONG_MAX - (ll)MOD * MOD;

void mmult(const vector<vector<int>>& A, const vector<vector<int>>& B, vector<vector<int>>& C) {
    int n = (int)A.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            ll cur = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (cur > LIM) cur %= MOD;
                cur += (ll)A[i][k] * B[k][j];
            }
            C[i][j] = (int)(cur % MOD);
        }
    }
}

void mcopy(const vector<vector<int>>& A, vector<vector<int>>& B) {
    int n = (int)A.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            B[i][j] = A[i][j];
}

    ll n; int base;
    cin >> n >> base;
    int sz = base + 1;
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> mat(60, vector<vector<int>>(base, vector<int>(sz, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i < base; ++i) {

            }
        }
    }
    int ci = 0, cj = 0; ll step = 1;
    while (step <= n / base) {
        ++ci;
        step *= base;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= ci; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < base; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < sz; ++k)
                for (int l = 0; l < sz; ++l)

            for (int k = 0; k < base; ++k) {
                vector<vector<int>> tmp(sz, vector<int>(sz));
                mmult(mat[i][j], mat[i-1][(j+k)%base], tmp);
                mcopy(tmp, mat[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    vector<vector<int>> have(sz, vector<int>(sz, 0));
    for (int k = 0; k < sz; ++k) have[k][k] = 1;
    for (; ci >= 0; --ci, step /= base) {

            if (++cj >= base) cj -= base;

    }
    int ret = 0;

        ret += have[k][base];
        if (ret >= MOD) ret -= MOD;
